name: 100% Orange Juice Visual Novel
source:
A fan-made 100% Orange Juice visual novel, set in a university AU. Play as Sora as she explores the world around her, meets new friends, and considers how to spend her university life.

[Edited from [url=https://thevulpinehero1.itch.io/100-orange-juice-visual-novel-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部由粉丝制作的100% 橙汁视觉小说，以大学AU为背景。扮演索拉探索周围的世界，结识新朋友，并考虑如何度过她的大学生活。

[编辑自[url=https://thevulpinehero1.itch.io/100-orange-juice-visual-novel-demo]itch.io[/url]]
